name: ddl_cost_class_5
notes: q_ddl M02 — the <=8-sector cost boundary WITHOUT writes. All reads (ioprio rides the BE/NONE heuristic branch; the RT/IDLE lanes are rig-untestable — trace_driver's io_uring O_DIRECT path does not propagate ioprio, see golden mqdd_prio_5 notes). nr=64 reads: cost=64 > Q_DDL_SMALL_SECTOR_THRESH(8) (q_ddl.bpf.c:35, :114-115; cost=nr_sectors, ioext_bpf_common.h:209) -> BULK lane. nr=8 reads: cost 8 <= 8 -> LAT lane. Fresh burst, rules 1-3 cold: rule 4 drains BULK arrival FIFO [2560, 3584] BEFORE rule 5 drains LAT arrival FIFO [5120, 4608, 3072], despite the interleaved arrival — proving the classification boundary reorders the batch. Extents non-adjacent: nr=64 reads span [2560,2624) and [3584,3648); next same-op read starts are 448..960 sectors away (start-to-start spacing >=512: 2560->3072->3584->4608->5120), so plug merging is physically impossible; q_ddl allow_merge=false (bpf.c:340-344) kills scheduler-queue merges. No power-of-two sector; all >=2560 (above partition-scan zone 0..2048).
